info.title: Redflie Business OS API
info.description: Customer auth (phone OTP, Google, rotating refresh tokens), staff/admin auth (password + TOTP, opaque sessions, RBAC), social accounts, scheduled posts and media.

post.summary: Verify an SMS OTP and sign in
Sign in with Google or obtain a phone-attach token
Revoke every session and invalidate all access tokens
Request an OTP for a new phone number
Link a Google account to the current customer

delete.summary: Unlink Google from the current customer

post.summary: Start staff sign-in with email and password
Verify a TOTP or recovery code and create a staff session
Confirm TOTP enrollment and create a staff session
Accept a staff invitation and set a password
Request a staff password reset email
Reset a staff password with a reset token
Elevate the current session for sensitive actions
Revoke all sessions for a staff member
Issue a read-only customer impersonation token
